name: actualbudget
label: Actual Budget
description: Open-source personal finance app with envelope budgeting (self-hosted)

server_url.label: Server URL
server_url.description: The URL of your Actual server, e.g. https://actual.example.com. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

password.label: Password
password.description: The password you use to log in to the server

sync_id.label: Sync ID
sync_id.description: Settings → Show advanced settings → Sync ID

encryption_password.label: End-to-end encryption password
encryption_password.description: Only if end-to-end encryption is turned on for this budget

get_categories.label: Get Categories
get_categories.description: Gets every budget category as a flat list.

get_accounts.label: Get Accounts
get_accounts.description: Gets every account in the budget (open and closed).

list_accounts.label: List Accounts
list_accounts.description: Lists accounts with their current balance.

list_categories.label: List Categories
list_categories.description: Lists category groups with their categories.

find_payees.label: Find Payees
find_payees.description: Finds payees whose name contains the search text (all payees when empty).

search.label: Name Contains
search.description: Part of the payee name, e.g. "kroger". Leave empty to list all payees.

delete_transaction.label: Delete Transaction
delete_transaction.description: Deletes a transaction (and its splits). This cannot be undone from the flow.

run_bank_sync.label: Run Bank Sync
run_bank_sync.description: Pulls new transactions from the bank for one linked account, or for all linked accounts.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Linked account to sync. Leave empty to sync all linked accounts.
